title: Message-framing checksum + soft-pin validator for tokenizer/template drift
creator: Asha Patel
description: During model onboarding we continue to see subtle mismatches between tokenizers and chat templates that only surface in long prompt tails or after quantization/profile transforms. This ticket implements a lightweight message-framing checksum and a "soft-pin" validator that flags probable delimiter/role drift during onboarding and suggests non-destructive template transforms. The goal is to reduce manual churn for model engineers when publishing performance profiles and pins.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime emits a stable framing checksum for each candidate model bundle during onboarding and includes it in onboarding metadata
Soft-pin validator runs as part of the onboarding pipeline and returns: compatible | warning | incompatible. Warnings contain human-readable diffs and suggested template fixes
CI includes tokenizer fuzz tests that exercise the most-common role delimiter patterns and fail if soft-pin returns incompatible for pinned models
Console shows the framing checksum and compatibility status on the model profile page and during pin rollout actions
Telemetry collected for false-positive/false-negative warnings with an initial threshold tuned from canary onboarding of 12 community models
tests: add corpus-based tokenizer fuzz test exercising role permutations and unicode whitespace variants
end-to-end onboarding job that emits compatibility status for the pinned bundle and fails gating job if incompatible
manual QA: onboard three internal models with known delimiter edge cases and validate console UI messages
rollout_plan: Stage 1 (Canary): run soft-pin validator in advisory-only mode for next 12 community model onboards (2 weeks)
Stage 2 (Opt-in): enable advisory advice in Console and allow engineers to apply suggested template transforms (2 weeks)
Stage 3 (Enforce): fail onboarding for 'incompatible' results for new pinned bundles unless override approved (depends on false-positive rate)
Monitoring: create dedicated telemetry dashboard and alert if onboard failure rate or override rate > 5%
decision: Implement checksum that hashes canonicalized message envelope (role tags + delimiter normalization) and store as onboarding metadata. Soft-pin validator will use token-level alignment heuristics + Levenshtein on delimiter-normalized strings. We chose heuristic approach over heavyweight byte-level canonicalization to reduce risk of breaking existing pinned bundles and to enable incremental tuning.
